## Requirements (from the contract §In-scope)
1. Run ER over the real spine (cascade 0-3 + Splink 4-5); materialise `resolution` envelopes as a
   NEW sqitch change (deploy/revert/verify), append-only, idempotent re-run (+0).
2. Bootstrap gold set: agent/maintainer stratified seed (oversample ambiguous bands) + LLM
   adjudicator (`adjudicator="llm:<model>@<version>"`, reads versioned adjudication_rules, rationale
   in note); disagreement -> disputed.
3. Calibrate LLM-vs-seed Cohen's κ (`GoldSet.kappa`); trust LLM gold only if κ ≥ 0.7; else suggester
   -> review. Frozen holdout is agent/maintainer-verified (never LLM-only); relabel of frozen refused.
4. Quality gates: pairwise P/R/F1 at tier boundaries + B-cubed on holdout + demote_auto_write_tiers
   (auto_write_precision_threshold ≥ 0.98, tuned to measured holdout) + cluster_shape_alerts. Any
   auto-write tier below floor -> demoted.
5. Review + active learning: tiers 4-5 + disputed clusters + model↔LLM disagreements + near-boundary
   pairs -> review_pg/review_queue.
6. Eval report (holdout P/R/F1, κ, dedup ratio, resolved-site count, demotions, cluster-shape alerts)
   -> docs/build/reports/ + surfaced on methodology/coverage page.

## Acceptance criteria (from the contract)
- [ ] ER runs over the real spine and materialises `resolution` envelopes (new sqitch change;

## Plan
- **New sqitch change `resolution_idempotency`** (mirrors `claim_content_digest`/ADR-059): add
  nullable `input_digest text` to `resolution` + partial UNIQUE index + append_only_guard row(s).
  Enables insert-only `ON CONFLICT DO NOTHING` -> idempotent re-run (+0). Additive/back-compat.
- **`reconcile/materialize.py`** — `materialize_resolutions(conn, ...)`: read claims per
  (subject,predicate) from the spine, run `RESOLVE`, INSERT resolution rows insert-only + idempotent.
  Skip predicates absent from the ruleset (KeyError) honestly. Returns a `MaterializeSummary`.
- **`resolution/adjudicator.py`** — `Adjudicator` protocol + `RuleBasedLLMAdjudicator`
  (`llm:rulebased@v1`, reads `adjudication_rules`, emits label + rationale). The gold bootstrap =
  agent/maintainer seed + LLM adjudicator; κ via `GoldSet.kappa`; disagreement -> disputed;
  holdout carries the human seed label.
- **`resolution/eval_loop.py`** — orchestrate: build gold set, κ gate, quality gates
  (P/R/F1 + B-cubed + demote + cluster-shape), active-learning review routing, emit `EvalReport`.
- Raise `auto_write_precision_threshold` 0.97 -> 0.98 (contract; tuned to measured holdout).
- Eval report -> `docs/build/reports/P28.1_resolution_eval.md`; PROVISIONAL (OSM land in flight).
- Live: run over hosted spine via cloud-sql-proxy if ADC available; else seeded test DB + honest
  deferral annotation.
